name: amass
description: Amass is a powerful network discovery and attack surface mapping tool that uses open-source information gathering and active reconnaissance techniques.

inputs.label: Target Domain (-d):
inputs.help: The primary domain name to enumerate.

inputs.label: Passive Mode (-passive)
inputs.help: Run in passive mode, using only data sources that do not require DNS requests or other active reconnaissance.

inputs.label: Active Mode (-active)
inputs.help: Run in active mode, performing more exhaustive enumeration using various techniques.

inputs.label: Brute Force (-brute)
inputs.help: Perform brute force subdomain enumeration. This can be time-consuming.

inputs.label: Wordlist Path (-w):
inputs.help: Path to a custom wordlist file for brute force and DNS permutations.

inputs.label: Upload Wordlist:
inputs.help: Upload a custom wordlist file for brute force.

inputs.label: CIDR (-cidr):
inputs.help: CIDR block to discover hosts within.

inputs.label: Ports (-p):
inputs.help: Ports to check for open services (e.g., '80,443').

inputs.label: Max DNS Queries (-max-dns-queries):
inputs.help: Maximum number of DNS queries to make.

inputs.label: Exclude Sources (-exclude):
inputs.help: Exclude specific data sources from the enumeration.

inputs.label: Include Sources (-include):
inputs.help: Only use specific data sources for the enumeration.

inputs.label: List All Sources (-list-sources)
inputs.help: List all available data sources without performing a scan.

inputs.label: Custom API Keys (-config):
inputs.help: Specify a configuration file with API keys for external services.

inputs.label: Upload Config File:
inputs.help: Upload a custom configuration file with API keys.

inputs.label: DNS Servers (-resolvers):
inputs.help: Comma-separated list of DNS server IP addresses to use.

inputs.label: Reverse DNS Lookup (-rdns)
inputs.help: Perform reverse DNS lookups on discovered IP addresses.

inputs.label: Output File (-o):
inputs.help: Save the enumeration results to a text file.

inputs.label: JSON Output (-json):
inputs.help: Save the enumeration results to a JSON file.

inputs.label: Verbose (-v)
inputs.help: Enable verbose output to see more details about the scan.

inputs.label: Show IPs (-ip)
inputs.help: Show IP addresses for discovered subdomains.

inputs.label: Show Reason (-whois)
inputs.help: Show WHOIS information for discovered assets.

inputs.label: Proxy (-proxy):
inputs.help: Use a proxy for all HTTP requests.

inputs.label: Threads (-t):
inputs.help: Number of concurrent threads to use.

inputs.label: Additional Arguments:
inputs.help: Any other Amass arguments not covered by the GUI. Enter them exactly as you would on the command line.

inputs.label: Domain List File (-df):
inputs.help: File containing a list of domains to enumerate (one per line).

inputs.label: Upload Domain List:
inputs.help: Upload a file with a list of domains to enumerate.
